headline: University Of Indonesia Dental Student Dies At Depok Apartment
seoTitle: UI Dental Student Dies At Depok Apartment
metaDescription: A student from the University of Indonesia's Faculty of Dentistry has died after falling from an apartment building located in the Pondok Cina area.
aiSummaryBullets: A student identified by the initials AR died after falling from the 12th floor of an apartment building in the Beji district of Depok.
The deceased was enrolled in the Faculty of Dentistry at the University of Indonesia.
Police are currently investigating the incident, which is suspected to be a case of suicide.
aiContextParagraph: On November 19, 2026, authorities reported that a student from the University of Indonesia was found deceased following a fall from an apartment building in the Mahata area of Pondok Cina, Depok. The student, identified as AR, was a member of the university's Faculty of Dentistry. Law enforcement officials have launched an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death, with preliminary reports suggesting the incident occurred after the student jumped from the 12th floor. The body has been recovered by local authorities for further processing. This event is distinct from unrelated reports regarding the death of a doctoral student at the same institution earlier in November, which were attributed by police to natural causes related to illness. Officials are continuing to look into the activities of the student prior to the incident as part of their ongoing inquiry into the matter.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to coverage by five independent media outlets and a high level of viral activity, reflecting significant public attention in Indonesia.
